title: PLS-BASED APPROACH FOR FAIR REPRESENTATION LEARNING

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the covariance between learned Partial Least Squares (PLS) representations and gender, as well as measuring the Disparate Impact of downstream classifiers trained on these representations using the Adult Income dataset.
Evaluating the covariance between the learned PLS representations and age, and measuring the Disparate Impact of downstream predictive models using the German Credit dataset.

Assessing the covariance between the learned representations and race, and computing fairness metrics such as Disparate Impact and Equality of Opportunity for downstream models using the Law School, Diabetes, COMPAS, and Communities and Crimes datasets.
